body: I stare at the envelope, feeling an overwhelming sense of unease wash over me. The address is my own name, but something feels off about this letter. My heart races as I read the contents, which seem too familiar yet strangely unsettling. Before I can gather my thoughts or act on any instincts I have felt, I know I need to put real distance between myself and it.
